category: Polish multi-hoster debrid, prepaid transfer with a registration credit

free_tier.stated: 'Otrzymujesz na start nawet 5 GB' - up to 5 GB of transfer on registration - and the header offers 'Załóż konto i wypróbuj za darmo'.
free_tier.notes: 'nawet' (up to) means 5 GB is a ceiling on the welcome credit, not a guaranteed amount.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: a transfer balance, not a per-file cap

retention.stated: not applicable: a link generator, nothing is stored

egress.terms: 'Nie ma żadnych ukrytych opłat' and 'Nie musisz kupować drogich kont premium'; transfer is prepaid and no speed cap is stated.

interface_detail: Web application: search a file, press download. No API, CLI or protocol endpoint is documented on the reachable pages.
tooling: Browser only as far as the site documents; no download-manager plugin or API is named.
chaining: The 5 GB welcome credit makes it the cheapest way to test whether Polish host coverage matches a user's sources before paying anything, and the per-GB price keeps it out of the base of the stack.

limits.value: prepaid transfer: 100 GB for 31,99 zł (reported); vendor says packages start 'już od 2 zł'

limits_note: 64 premium accounts are bundled in one account ('64 kont w cenie jednego'). No per-host daily cap, concurrency limit or fair-use paragraph is published.
binding_note: The balance runs out long before any rate or shaping limit could apply.

identity_cost.detail: The signup panel asks for login, email and password with a terms checkbox, and the login form is behind a Cloudflare Turnstile widget. No card at registration.

reliability_note: Different build and different analytics property from Pobierz.biz and RapidTraffic.pl, so it is a separate operator rather than a third brand of the same twin; the site also quotes prices 'od 2 zł' that its own package list does not show.
confidence_note: The 5 GB welcome credit, the 64-account bundle and the Turnstile-guarded signup are vendor-stated and read. The package price comes from a third-party Polish calculator (debrid.pl, prices dated 12.10.2026) because the vendor's /cennik page renders mostly testimonials and no package table in static HTML.

evidence.proved: 'Otrzymujesz na start nawet 5 GB', '64 kont w cenie jednego - już od 2 zł', 'Nie ma żadnych ukrytych opłat'
the package 'transfer 1 × 100 GB' at 31,99 zł, 0,32 zł/GB, in a calculator whose prices are dated 12.10.2026
a GA property (G-WSTJ2QMGRD) and page build distinct from Pobierz.biz/RapidTraffic.pl, which rules out the white-label twin hypothesis for this third Polish brand

notes: The third Polish brand at the same PLN 31.99 / 100 GB price point as the Pobierz.biz twin, but on a different build, so the shared price is a market price rather than one operator. The 5 GB welcome credit is the largest no-card free start found.
